analysis: Examined the added requantizer, requirements metadata/patch/full text, and test-file metadata; the test implementation is not supplied beyond a bounded orientation excerpt. requant.py:39-105 introduces remote JSON/header/range reads; 343-419 converts source weights and copies template artifacts. Range lengths are checked, but reads are unbounded and manifest paths escape the output root as reported. The standalone script does not verify template manifest hashes, enforce pinned HTTPS source revisions, or automatically invoke selftest before build (551-573). These are integration contracts to reconcile with .github/workflows/model-requant-upload.yml and scripts/models/upload-model-revision.py, not proof of a publication bypass from this batch. Review how tested candidate digests bind downloaded inputs and final uploaded artifacts, relevant to A-004, T-012, T-027 and T-007; extend the model for this build/publication trust boundary if needed. requirements-requant-upload.txt:6-162 pins versions and hashes, but actual --require-hashes/--only-binary enforcement and dependency completeness require the workflow evidence. No runtime authorization, attestation, encryption, billing, prompt handling or T-041 cache behavior changes are visible here. Tests and workflow must establish whether upstream validation mitigates the reported path issue and whether reproducibility gates fail closed; missing source limits this local conclusion.

findings.detail: cmd_build takes each path directly from the downloaded template manifest and opens os.path.join(a.out, p) for writing without checking containment. A template endpoint serving a manifest entry such as '../existing-file' or an absolute path can supply bytes that overwrite any writable file at that location, rather than merely supplying model data. Creating a fresh output directory does not prevent this escape. This introduces a remote-data-to-local-filesystem write boundary in the new build tool. Reject absolute paths, traversal components and noncanonical paths before downloading or writing; enforce containment beneath the output directory and prevent symlink following.
findings.title: Remote manifest paths can overwrite files outside the build directory
